Senses.Explanation: Release and seize names a paired operation of encounter: allowing room and taking control, sometimes exercised together and sometimes alternated freely. Records coordinate the pair with guest-and-host, killing-and-giving-life, rolling-up-and-unrolling, or unfixed handling of the situation. It describes observable control of the public exchange, not an inward state.
